summary: End-to-end QA testing on preview URL https://aviation-erp-2.preview.emergentagent.com covering all 9 role logins, sub-page navigation, ASRE Smart Booking, Phone OTP, Google OAuth presence, logout, public pages, and role-based permissions. Previous CEO (/admin?tab=ceo) and Pilot (/pilot-portal) redirect bugs from iteration_31 are FIXED and verified — 9/9 roles now land on their correct dashboards via ROLE_HOME_PATH map in LoginPage.js. New issues found: (1) /customer/carbon returns 404 despite being linked in sidebar, (2) /contact public page returns 404, (3) Phone OTP fails because SMS_MOCK_MODE=false in backend/.env, causing real Twilio calls that error with 'unverified number' for the test phone +919999999999, (4) Invalid-login response returns 429 Too Many Requests instead of 401 (rate limiter/lockout kicks in aggressively; no error alert surfaces in UI, form silently stays on /login).

minor.issue: Backend calls real Twilio (SMS_MOCK_MODE=false in backend/.env) → 400 with 'The phone number is unverified. Trial accounts cannot send messages to unverified numbers'. Blocks Phone OTP login testing. Credentials doc says mock OTP 123456 should work — flip SMS_MOCK_MODE=true (or add per-env override) to unblock QA.

Schema uses field name 'otp_code' but frontend sample uses 'otp'. Test client posting {'otp': '123456'} returned 422 'otp_code Field required'. Confirm frontend payload key matches backend Pydantic model.

Repeated invalid-password attempts return 429 immediately (rate limit / account lockout) with no 401 seen even after 30-second wait. UI shows no error banner — user experience is a silent no-op. Consider surfacing 429 message and lowering aggressiveness for benign form typos.

ui_bugs.issue: Route /customer/carbon is NOT declared in App.js (present routes: /customer/trips, /customer/refunds, /customer/auctions, /customer/smart-booking, etc.). Clicking the sidebar item lands on 404 NotFoundPage. The CarbonCalculator component IS imported inside CustomerDashboard.js and referenced in its case-switch but the deep-link route is missing.

GET /contact renders 404 NotFoundPage. Landing page 'Contact' nav link uses in-page anchor href='#contact', so deep-linking or sharing /contact fails. Add a Route element for /contact OR remove /contact from the review scope.

Wrong password produces no visible error toast/alert; form silently stays on /login (backend returns 429 due to rate limiter). Users cannot tell login failed. Add explicit error banner rendering for 401 and 429.
Persistent red 'CRITICAL SECURITY ALERT — CRITICAL Risk Login Detected-hacker@test.com' banner still shown from previous iteration. Non-dismissible.

integration_issues.issue: UI 'Send OTP' click posts to /api/auth/phone/send-otp; backend returns 400 (Twilio unverified). No visible error toast in UI — silent failure. Root cause is backend env (SMS_MOCK_MODE=false), but the UI should still surface the error.
Console: 'Failed to load refunds: AxiosError' and network 403 on refunds resource. Page still renders but with empty data.

action_items: Add <Route path='/customer/carbon' element={<CarbonCalculator/>} /> (or nested customer route) in App.js so sidebar link doesn't 404.
Add a public <Route path='/contact' ...> or remove /contact from user-facing tests (currently only #contact anchor exists on landing page).
Set SMS_MOCK_MODE=true in backend/.env for preview so mock OTP 123456 works, matching /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
Confirm phone verify-otp payload field name — backend expects 'otp_code'. Ensure frontend sends the same key.
Show a user-visible error message on LoginPage when POST /api/auth/login returns 401 or 429 (currently silent).
Investigate 403 on /customer/refunds fetch — either seed the endpoint or handle empty state cleanly.
Gate/remove the seeded 'hacker@test.com' CRITICAL SECURITY ALERT on AdminDashboard for preview.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js: sidebar link exists for /customer/carbon but no matching <Route> — dead deep-link. Same class of bug fixed in iteration_31 for CEO. Consider a lint/test that iterates every sidebar item across dashboards and asserts a matching Route exists.
backend/.env has SMS_MOCK_MODE=false while service default is true and credentials doc promises mock OTP. Env is out of sync with documented QA workflow.
LoginPage: no error UI branch for 429; only handles generic failure without rendering an alert. Add explicit toast/inline error.
test_credentials: All 9 accounts in /app/memory/test_credentials.md authenticated successfully (200). Phone +919999999999 unusable until SMS_MOCK_MODE=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_31 CEO/Pilot 404 bugs are FIXED (verified 9/9 roles land on correct dashboard). Focus next retest on: (a) /customer/carbon route added and CarbonCalculator renders; (b) /contact public route; (c) SMS_MOCK_MODE=true → send-otp returns 200 with mock_otp:'123456' → verify-otp completes login with token; (d) Login form shows an error alert for wrong password / 429 lockout. Playwright login pattern: fill [data-testid=email-input]+[data-testid=password-input], click [data-testid=submit-btn], wait for URL change. Logout via [data-testid*=logout] works across all dashboards.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) /customer/carbon 404 — CustomerDashboard sidebar declares path:'/customer/carbon' and renders CarbonCalculator in its tab switch, but App.js has no <Route path='/customer/carbon'>, so React Router falls to the wildcard 404 route. Fix: add the route (or a wildcard /customer/* that delegates to CustomerDashboard). 2) /contact 404 — landing page uses href='#contact' anchor only; a top-level /contact route was never registered. 3) Phone OTP — sms_otp_service.SMS_MOCK_MODE defaults true, but /app/backend/.env explicitly sets SMS_MOCK_MODE=false, forcing real Twilio; trial number restrictions block +919999999999. Flip env to true or use a verified Twilio number for QA.
